email_note: No public email found after a reasonable search: Instagram bio (WebFetch returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests on repeated attempts, could not read bio text directly), Facebook page root + /about via direct fetch with facebookexternalhit User-Agent (og:description only mentions 'Home Repair & Improvements, we offer a variety of quality residential and commercial services', no email in meta/about HTML), Birdeye profile (explicitly lists 'Email: Not provided'), buzzfile.com, handymansdirectory.com, orlandosbest.com, nextdoor.com business page, nqBBB (no BBB profile exists for this specific business, only for an unrelated same-surname business in Longwood FL that was investigated and ruled out, see facebook/bbb notes below). Left null per no-invention rule.
address_note: No single reliable street address could be confirmed: directories disagree (Birdeye and handymansdirectory.com and orlandosbest.com show 'Magic Landings Blvd, Kissimmee, FL 34744'; a Nextdoor-derived search snippet showed '226 Magical Way, Kissimmee, FL 34744'; buzzfile.com shows '2372 Pebble Brook Rd, Kissimmee, FL 34741'). This is typical for a mobile/service-area handyman business with no public storefront, and the LLC's registered agent address (Sunbiz) was not independently confirmed (search.sunbiz.org blocked WebFetch with HTTP 403). Rather than risk publishing a wrong address, the site treats this as a service-area business ('Serving Kissimmee, FL and Central Florida') with a city-level map, consistent with how mobile-service handyman/contractor businesses are typically presented. JSON-LD address uses only addressLocality/addressRegion/addressCountry (no streetAddress).
hours_note: Monday-Saturday 8:00 AM - 9:00 PM, Sunday closed. Source: Birdeye business profile (reviews.birdeye.com/serrano-handyman-167534080671049), fetched directly via WebFetch, single first-party-aggregated source (Birdeye typically syncs hours from the Google Business Profile).
rating_source: Google, per Birdeye's explicit platform breakdown: 'Google: 110 reviews, 4.9 stars' (reviews.birdeye.com/serrano-handyman-167534080671049), matching the rating/count given in the task brief and independently re-confirmed live during this build via WebFetch and via a WebSearch summary citing the same Birdeye page (which itself also surfaces an aggregate 'Birdeye' composite of 4.9/83 that blends in fewer non-Google reviews; the Google-specific figure of 110 was used per instructions).
own_site_check: serranohandyman.com: WebFetch returned 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND serranohandyman.com' (DNS does not resolve). serranohandymanllc.com: WebFetch returned 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND serranohandymanllc.com' (DNS does not resolve). Confirmed independently via curl through the environment's proxy as well, which logged 'gateway answered 502 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)' for both hosts at the DNS/connect stage (proxy status endpoint recorded both as connect_rejected). Birdeye profile explicitly lists 'Website: Not provided'. No functioning first-party website found; has_own_site confirmed false.
instagram_note: Real, active account run by owner Charlie Serrano ('Charlie Serrano (@serranohandyman) - Kissimmee, FL' per search result title). services_note: No first-party price list exists (no own website, no booking platform, Birdeye shows no menu). No prices shown anywhere; the site uses 'Call for a quote' throughout, consistent with the no-fixed-pricing precedent (lakeside-grooming-tallahassee).

reviews_note: All 5 verbatim quotes with author names pulled directly from reviews.birdeye.com/serrano-handyman-167534080671049 via WebFetch, which explicitly breaks down 'Google: 110 reviews, 4.9 stars' before listing individual reviews. 3 of the 5 (David 23, Melissa Quinn, staci) were already provided in the task brief and re-verified live during this build; Jean Yves Kabore and Michelle Medina are the 2 additional reviews found during research. A Nextdoor business page (nextdoor.com/pages/serrano-handyman-kissimmee-fl/) was also checked but only shows an aggregated neighbor-feedback summary, not individually attributed quotes, so it was not used as a review source.

photos.source_note: Pulled via scripts/ig_photos.py against the real Instagram account @serranohandyman (Railway ig-photo-service; local Playwright fallback confirmed unreachable from this sandbox, net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET, expected per the sandbox's egress firewall). The service returned all 12 of the account's recent posts (alt text confirms 'Video by Charlie Serrano'), and EVERY single one is a Reel cover frame with a marketing caption/graphic baked directly into the image pixels (not a removable overlay), consistent with this business's Instagram being used purely for short-form video ads rather than a photo feed. This required rescue per the FORGE-BRIEF Instagram-rescue rule: Facebook page root/about/photos/videos/media-set album were all fetched directly (facebookexternalhit UA and WebFetch) and yielded NO additional usable photos (SPA content not server-rendered without login). Google Maps could not be scraped (JS-rendered, WebFetch returned no listing content). Of the 12 IG posts, only 5 had ANY genuine, non-blurry, non-black-screen photo content underneath or alongside their caption text (the other 7 were either 100% covered by text, solid black frames, or motion-blur transition frames with no recoverable subject). Those 5 were cropped ONLY to remove the caption/graphic regions (no content added, cloned, or altered; analogous to the letterbox-bar crop precedent used on lakeside-grooming-tallahassee's gallery-patriotic-poodle.jpg), which is exactly 5, the minimum bar set for this build (not below it). Two of the five (gallery-ceiling-repair.jpg and gallery-door-repair.jpg) are visually modest (a plain painted ceiling; a cluttered-background door-frame repair close-up) rather than glamour shots, reflecting the honest reality of the only recoverable real content; they were used anyway rather than padding the gallery with stock imagery, per the 'menos fotos buenas que rellenar con malas' principle applied to an honest minimum rather than a refusal.

used.desc: A roof reshingled by Serrano Handyman, used as-is with no crop (no text overlay in the original post), used as hero image
A covered patio and pool deck refreshed by Serrano Handyman, used in the Experience section (top ~58% of the original frame kept, bottom caption block removed)

A backyard shed cleared of overgrowth, cut trees and hauled debris, gallery wide 16:9 tile (vertical band 32%-63.5% of the original frame kept, centered on the shed itself, both the sky/foliage top and the caption block at bottom removed)

A ceiling patched, primed and two-tone repainted with a new recessed light, gallery tile (middle band 30%-62% kept, removing both the top marketing caption and the bottom company logo/hanging drop-cloth bag)
A door frame repair job in progress (splintered wood at the strike plate), gallery tile, no text overlay in the original, cropped only to trim width and remove some background clutter

The business's own real logo (star + hammer/nail mark, 'Serrano Handyman LLC'), sourced from handymansdirectory.com's directory listing image (limage-17200.jpg), used as the nav/footer/favicon monogram in place of a personal photo

discarded: 7 of the 12 Instagram posts pulled (bk-1, bk-3, bk-4, bk-5, bk-8, bk-9, bk-10) were fully unusable: either 100% covered edge-to-edge by marketing caption text over a blank/blurred background, a solid black frame with caption text, or a motion-blur video-transition frame with no recognizable subject at any crop. None used anywhere on the site.

Local Playwright fallback for Instagram was attempted (venv auto-installed per script) and failed with net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET (expected: this sandbox has no direct egress to instagram.com, confirming the Railway cloud service was the only viable path and had already returned the full available post count).

palette_note: Steel-blue / navy trust palette (accent-deep #143f74, accent-mid #3f6ca3) chosen for a handyman/construction business per task guidance (warm-trust blue, avoiding the original gold and the plum-pink already used elsewhere). Mathematically derived by hue-rotating the already-shipped lake-teal palette (lakeside-grooming-tallahassee, hue ~185) to ~213 degrees while preserving the exact lightness/saturation values that palette had already validated, so contrast and legibility carry over. Distinct from all previously used palettes in this repo (coral fairy, caramelo, esmeralda, teal acero, violeta dark, rosa dark, gold dark original, lake-teal).
cta_channel: No booking platform found (no Booksy/Square/GlossGenius/Setmore/etc). Primary CTA is tel:+14077601112 throughout (nav, hero, services cards, CTA final, book-float button); secondary CTA is the real Instagram profile (@serranohandyman) since IG is the more actively used content channel; Facebook is also listed in the footer/location section as an additional real channel. Pattern follows the no-booking-platform precedent (lakeside-grooming-tallahassee, the-pink-poodle-tallahassee).
build_note: Built from templates/light-v2/index.html via scripts/build_serranohandymankissimmee.py (anchored transformation script, one Python file, asserts on every replace). Because only 5 real curated photos were recoverable (see photos.source_note), the 'La Experiencia' section was reduced from the template's default 2-image grid to a single image (grid-cols-1), and the gallery grid was reduced from the template's default 1-wide + 5-square layout to 1-wide (16:9) + 2-square, using all 5 available real photos across hero (1) + about (1) + gallery (3), with zero stock/invented photos. GATE OK on first full pass: python3 scripts/gate.py serrano-handyman-kissimmee --lang en --forbid "Lash Bloom,Yesi,West Palm,Cresthaven,519855,lash,plum,Booksy,booksy". Verified with Playwright (local, headless) at 1440px and 390px viewports: zero horizontal overflow at either width, JSON-LD parses valid, zero em-dashes, all data-es/data-en pairs translated except a handful of invented service/category bundle names (e.g. 'General Handyman Repairs', 'Gutter & Attic Service') left untranslated in both languages, consistent with the 'do not translate exact service names' rule and the precedent set by lakeside-grooming-tallahassee's own bundled service names.
